metadata.title: Regularity of varifolds with bounded anisotropic first variation
metadata.abstract: We prove an $\varepsilon$-regularity theorem for $m$-varifolds with mean curvature in $L^p$, $p>m$, with respect to an anisotropic integrand satisfying a Michael-Simon inequality and the quadratic exposed condition: near sufficiently flat density-one points, such varifolds are representable as $C^{1,\alpha}$ graphs. Combined with the recent proof of the anisotropic Michael-Simon inequality, this establishes an anisotropic Allard regularity theorem in arbitrary codimension for a large class of anisotropic integrands, including those close to the area functional. We also exhibit the first examples of anisotropies satisfying both the uniform scalar atomic condition and the Michael-Simon inequality, that are not close to any ellipsoidal norm. These include the $\ell^q$ norms in every dimension and codimension, for explicit ranges of $q$, and a new class of axisymmetric anisotropies.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 在特定各向异性积分泛函下，证明平均曲率 Lᵖ（p>m）varifold 在足够平坦密度1点附近的 C¹,α 图像正则性，并给出远离椭球范数的适用例子。
techniques: 各向异性 Michael–Simon 不等式
Lipschitz 图逼近与一致 Legendre–Hadamard 椭圆性
analysis.breakthrough: 扩展任意余维 Allard 型正则性并显著扩大非微扰各向异性例子。
analysis.limitations: 不是所有各向异性被覆盖；需区分正则性定理的条件与例子验证的条件，并保留 p>m、密度1和平坦性。 已补读PDF第1–3页定理1.1–1.4。须有QEC和Michael–Simon不等式，p>m且p≥2，并满足质量比、曲率项及倾斜超额小量条件；不是全部各向异性自动正则。 未逐行核验完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索和命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 LLM 辅助命题4.1中寻找使 ℓq 各向异性满足 USAC 的指数范围，作者重写论证并补充中间引理；后文 A_I 是数学符号，不另作 AI 证据。
